---
title: "DPMM uncertainty quantification for integrated squared density"
output: html_document
---

This notebook evaluates DPMM credible intervals for integrated squared density
under the standard Laplace density. Results are saved after each replication;
completed replications are skipped on rerun.

```{r dpmm-coverage}
DIMENSION <- 1L
N_REPETITIONS <- 1000L
N_TRAIN <- 5000L
POSTERIOR_DRAWS <- 1000L
TRUE_ISD <- 0.25  # exact: integral (exp(-|z|)/2)^2 dz
CREDIBLE_LEVEL <- 0.95
MASTER_SEED <- 2026L
OVERWRITE <- FALSE

BURN_IN <- 1000L

if (!requireNamespace("BNPmix", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install BNPmix first with install.packages('BNPmix').")
}

sample_laplace <- function(n) {
  matrix(rexp(n * DIMENSION) - rexp(n * DIMENSION), ncol = DIMENSION)
}

fit_dpmm <- function(x, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  BNPmix::PYdensity(
    y = as.numeric(x),
    mcmc = list(
      niter = BURN_IN + POSTERIOR_DRAWS, nburn = BURN_IN,
      method = "ICS", model = "LS", hyper = TRUE, print_message = FALSE
    ),
    prior = list(strength = 1, discount = 0),
    # Return mixture parameters without evaluating a density grid.
    output = list(out_type = "CLUST", out_param = TRUE)
  )
}

gaussian_mixture_isd <- function(fit) {
  vapply(seq_along(fit$probs), function(i) {
    weights <- as.numeric(fit$probs[[i]])
    means <- as.numeric(fit$mean[[i]])
    variances <- as.numeric(fit$sigma2[[i]])
    overlap <- dnorm(
      outer(means, means, "-"),
      sd = sqrt(outer(variances, variances, "+"))
    )
    sum(outer(weights, weights) * overlap)
  }, numeric(1))
}

project_root <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
if (basename(project_root) == "notebooks") project_root <- dirname(project_root)
result_dir <- file.path(project_root, "results", "posterior_uncertainty")
output_file <- file.path(result_dir, "laplace_isd_coverage_dpmm.csv")
summary_file <- file.path(result_dir, "laplace_isd_coverage_dpmm_summary.csv")
dir.create(dirname(output_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

columns <- c(
  "repetition", "data_seed", "mcmc_seed", "n_train", "posterior_draws",
  "burn_in", "credible_level", "integration", "true_isd",
  "posterior_mean", "posterior_sd", "bias", "interval_length", "ci_lower",
  "ci_upper", "covered", "fit_and_posterior_time_seconds",
  "total_time_seconds"
)

add_checkpoint_summary <- function(x) {
  summary_columns <- c(
    "posterior_mean", "posterior_sd", "bias", "interval_length", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "covered",
    "fit_and_posterior_time_seconds", "total_time_seconds"
  )
  mean_row <- as.list(rep(NA, ncol(x)))
  se_row <- as.list(rep(NA, ncol(x)))
  names(mean_row) <- names(se_row) <- names(x)
  mean_row$repetition <- "Mean"
  se_row$repetition <- "Standard error"
  for (column in summary_columns) {
    values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[[column]]))
    values <- values[is.finite(values)]
    if (length(values)) mean_row[[column]] <- mean(values)
    if (length(values) > 1L) {
      se_row[[column]] <- sd(values) / sqrt(length(values))
    }
  }
  rbind(x, as.data.frame(mean_row, check.names = FALSE),
        as.data.frame(se_row, check.names = FALSE))
}

write_checkpoint_csv <- function(x, path, add_summary = TRUE) {
  if (add_summary) x <- add_checkpoint_summary(x)
  temporary <- paste0(path, ".tmp")
  write.csv(x, temporary, row.names = FALSE)
  if (!file.copy(temporary, path, overwrite = TRUE)) stop("Could not update ", path)
  unlink(temporary)
}

if (file.exists(output_file) && !OVERWRITE) {
  results <- read.csv(output_file, check.names = FALSE)
  if (!setequal(names(results), columns)) {
    stop("Saved result columns do not match this experiment. Use a separate output file or clear the incompatible results.")
  }
  numeric_repetition <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(results$repetition))
  results <- results[!is.na(numeric_repetition), , drop = FALSE]
  results$repetition <- numeric_repetition[!is.na(numeric_repetition)]
  numeric_columns <- setdiff(columns, c("covered", "integration"))
  results[numeric_columns] <- lapply(
    results[numeric_columns], function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  )
  results$covered <- results$ci_lower <= TRUE_ISD & TRUE_ISD <= results$ci_upper
  if (nrow(results)) {
    expected_settings <- list(
      n_train = N_TRAIN, posterior_draws = POSTERIOR_DRAWS,
      burn_in = BURN_IN, credible_level = CREDIBLE_LEVEL,
      integration = "analytic", true_isd = TRUE_ISD
    )
    for (column in names(expected_settings)) {
      if (!all(results[[column]] == expected_settings[[column]])) {
        stop("Saved results: ", column, " does not match the current experiment")
      }
    }
    if (any(results$data_seed != MASTER_SEED + results$repetition - 1L) ||
        any(results$mcmc_seed != MASTER_SEED + 2000000L + results$repetition - 1L)) {
      stop("Saved results: random seeds do not match")
    }
  }
} else {
  results <- as.data.frame(setNames(replicate(length(columns), logical(0), simplify = FALSE), columns))
}
write_checkpoint_csv(results, output_file)
cat(sprintf("true ISD = %.10g (exact)\n", TRUE_ISD))
cat("output =", output_file, "\n")

tail_probability <- (1 - CREDIBLE_LEVEL) / 2
completed <- if (nrow(results)) as.integer(results$repetition) else integer(0)

for (repetition in seq_len(N_REPETITIONS)) {
  if (repetition %in% completed) next
  cat(sprintf("DPMM repetition %04d/%04d started at %s.\n",
              repetition, N_REPETITIONS, format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S")))
  flush.console()
  total_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  data_seed <- MASTER_SEED + repetition - 1L
  set.seed(data_seed)
  x_train <- sample_laplace(N_TRAIN)

  mcmc_seed <- MASTER_SEED + 2000000L + repetition - 1L
  fit_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  fit <- fit_dpmm(x_train, mcmc_seed)
  isd_draws <- gaussian_mixture_isd(fit)
  if (length(isd_draws) != POSTERIOR_DRAWS) stop("Unexpected number of posterior draws")
  interval <- quantile(
    isd_draws, c(tail_probability, 1 - tail_probability), names = FALSE
  )
  total_time <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - total_start
  fit_and_posterior_time <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - fit_start

  row <- data.frame(
    repetition = repetition,
    data_seed = data_seed,
    mcmc_seed = mcmc_seed,
    n_train = N_TRAIN,
    posterior_draws = POSTERIOR_DRAWS,
    burn_in = BURN_IN,
    credible_level = CREDIBLE_LEVEL,
    integration = "analytic",
    true_isd = TRUE_ISD,
    posterior_mean = mean(isd_draws),
    posterior_sd = sd(isd_draws),
    bias = mean(isd_draws) - TRUE_ISD,
    interval_length = interval[[2]] - interval[[1]],
    ci_lower = interval[[1]],
    ci_upper = interval[[2]],
    covered = interval[[1]] <= TRUE_ISD && TRUE_ISD <= interval[[2]],
    fit_and_posterior_time_seconds = fit_and_posterior_time,
    total_time_seconds = total_time
  )
  results <- rbind(results, row)
  results <- results[order(as.integer(results$repetition)), columns]
  write_checkpoint_csv(results, output_file)

  cat(sprintf(
    "  finished: coverage=%.3f, replicate_time=%.1fs\n",
    mean(as.logical(results$covered)), total_time
  ))
  flush.console()
}

coverage <- mean(as.logical(results$covered))
summary <- data.frame(
  method = "BNPmix Gaussian DPMM (ICS, location-scale mixture)",
  integration = "analytic",
  truth = "Laplace(0, 1)",
  dimension = DIMENSION,
  completed_repetitions = nrow(results),
  true_isd_exact = TRUE_ISD,
  coverage_rate = coverage,
  coverage_monte_carlo_se = sqrt(coverage * (1 - coverage) / nrow(results)),
  mean_interval_width = mean(results$ci_upper - results$ci_lower),
  mean_bias = mean(results$bias),
  mean_fit_and_posterior_time_seconds = mean(results$fit_and_posterior_time_seconds),
  se_fit_and_posterior_time_seconds = sd(results$fit_and_posterior_time_seconds) / sqrt(nrow(results)),
  mean_total_time_seconds = mean(results$total_time_seconds),
  total_compute_time_seconds = sum(results$total_time_seconds)
)
write_checkpoint_csv(summary, summary_file, add_summary = FALSE)
print(summary)
```

## Posterior comparison on a shared dataset

This section generates one Laplace dataset and saves it with the DPMM ISD
posterior draws. The final section of `02_posterior_uncertainty.ipynb` fits GEB
to the saved dataset and plots both posterior distributions. Run this section
before generating the comparison figure in Python.

```{r posterior-comparison}
COMPARISON_DATA_SEED <- 2034L
COMPARISON_MCMC_SEED <- 2002026L

comparison_dir <- file.path(project_root, "results", "posterior_uncertainty")
dir.create(comparison_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

comparison_settings <- data.frame(
  data_seed = COMPARISON_DATA_SEED,
  mcmc_seed = COMPARISON_MCMC_SEED,
  n_train = N_TRAIN,
  posterior_draws = POSTERIOR_DRAWS,
  burn_in = BURN_IN,
  integration = "analytic"
)
settings_file <- file.path(comparison_dir, "posterior_comparison_settings.csv")
comparison_files <- file.path(comparison_dir, c(
  "x_train.csv", "dpmm_draws.csv", "posterior_comparison_settings.csv"
))
comparison_complete <- !OVERWRITE && all(file.exists(comparison_files)) &&
  isTRUE(all.equal(read.csv(settings_file), comparison_settings, check.attributes = FALSE))
if (comparison_complete) {
  comparison_complete <- nrow(read.csv(comparison_files[[1]])) == N_TRAIN &&
    nrow(read.csv(comparison_files[[2]])) == POSTERIOR_DRAWS
}
if (comparison_complete) {
  cat("Comparison data and posterior draws already saved; skipped.\n")
} else {
  set.seed(COMPARISON_DATA_SEED)
  comparison_x <- sample_laplace(N_TRAIN)
  cat("Fitting DPMM to the comparison dataset.\n")
  flush.console()
  comparison_fit <- fit_dpmm(comparison_x, COMPARISON_MCMC_SEED)
  comparison_dpmm_isd <- gaussian_mixture_isd(comparison_fit)

  write.csv(
    data.frame(x = as.numeric(comparison_x)),
    file.path(comparison_dir, "x_train.csv"), row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    data.frame(isd = comparison_dpmm_isd),
    file.path(comparison_dir, "dpmm_draws.csv"), row.names = FALSE
  )
  write.csv(
    comparison_settings,
    file.path(comparison_dir, "posterior_comparison_settings.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  cat("Saved comparison data and DPMM posterior draws to: ",
      comparison_dir, "\n", sep = "")
}
```
